# Retail POS 3.0.0-RC6

Retail POS 3.0.0-RC6 focuses on faster product lookup at the till, direct batch changes in the catalogue, and a clearer way into sales and administration.

## Highlights

- The sales product finder shows current stock, labels tax-inclusive prices as PVP, and filters with a live search plus a category list.
- Category filters include products from nested subcategories in both sales and catalogue search.
- Several products can be updated together: category and tax-inclusive sale price, with a live preview, retry for failed rows, and undo for successful writes.
- The opening screen for sales and administration has been redesigned, including keyboard navigation between administrator choices.

## Distribution

This release candidate is distributed as portable x86_64 packages for Linux, Windows, and Intel macOS. Windows and macOS packages include a bundled Java runtime; the Linux package uses the system Java installation. Every package includes a SHA256 checksum.

Native installers, Apple Silicon support, Linux ARM64 support, and platform signing remain planned follow-up work.
